title: Teaching with AI: Today and Tomorrow

program.section_heading: Teaching with AI: Today and Tomorrow Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to leverage the benefits of AI to support student learning and make work more efficient.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to manage the limitations of AI through an understanding of privacy and ethical issues as well as AI-resilient assessment practices.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply an understanding of long-term considerations of AI to guide current implementation strategies.

blocks.name: Core Courses- 18 hours (Credits listed are in hours)

notes: Noncredit certificate counted in hours: the description says '18-hour certificate' and the block heading says 'Credits listed are in hours'; all units fields hold hours.
The catalog prints codes without a space (ACTCB68AN, ACTCB68BN); these match closed-list ACTC B68AN and ACTC B68BN.
The eLumen layout prints values as '9 - 0' and '(Total 18 - 0)'. These were read as 9 hours per course and 18 hours total, not as ranges.

The description says the program 'prepares current and future teachers'. This names the audience rather than a stated career outcome, so careers was left empty; a reviewer may want to check that reading.
The URL slug references 'summer-2025' while the catalog year is 2026-2027.
